span.p: Audit findings

div.style: color: rgb(11, 18, 32) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: ✅ Deny-by-default via FallbackPolicy — a new endpoint is protected unless it opts out

div.style: color: rgb(11, 18, 32) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
⚠️ POST /{id}/local-result is unauthenticated by design and unowned:
anyone who knows a DuelId can write that side's result while the duel is running.
Mitigations: ULID ids, first-writer-wins, no ELO effect without a verdict.

div.style: color: rgb(11, 18, 32) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
⚠️ Features:AllowAnonymousWrites=true in appsettings.Development.json opens
POST /api/duels and POST /{id}/verdict. Read once at startup — a restart is needed to change it.

div.style: color: rgb(11, 18, 32) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
⚠️ /api/dev/reset wipes Duels, DuelResults, EloHistory and resets every model to 1200 ELO,
anonymously. Development-only mapping is the ONLY thing protecting it.

div.style: color: rgb(11, 18, 32) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: ℹ️ No role or scope is ever required. Roles exist in claims and /auth/me but gate nothing.

div.style: color: rgb(11, 18, 32) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: ℹ️ OwnerId / VerdictBy are recorded but never checked — any signed-in user can judge any duel.

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;

span.p: Client-side gate (defence in depth, not a control)

div.style: color: rgb(11, 18, 32) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: _Imports.razor: @attribute [Authorize] on every routed page

div.style: color: rgb(11, 18, 32) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: App.razor AuthorizeRouteView renders Login.razor when unauthenticated

div.style: color: rgb(11, 18, 32) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: BffAuthenticationStateProvider polls GET /auth/me — the SERVER is the authority

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;

span.p: Route groups and their guard

div.style: color: rgb(11, 18, 32) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
MapGroup /api/duels .RequireAuthorization()
├ POST / — opened by Features:AllowAnonymousWrites
├ POST /{id}/verdict — opened by Features:AllowAnonymousWrites
├ POST /{id}/local-result — ALWAYS .AllowAnonymous()
└ GET /, /{id}, /demo-plan — always authenticated

div.style: color: rgb(11, 18, 32) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
MapGroup /api/models .RequireAuthorization()
└ GET /download-status/{id} — .AllowAnonymous()

div.style: color: rgb(11, 18, 32) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: MapGroup /api/leaderboard .RequireAuthorization() — no opt-outs

div.style: color: rgb(11, 18, 32) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: MapGroup /api/ollama .RequireAuthorization() — no opt-outs

div.style: color: rgb(11, 18, 32) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: GET /api/duels/{id}/report .RequireAuthorization()

div.style: color: rgb(11, 18, 32) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
MapHub DuelHub /hubs/duel .RequireAuthorization()
JoinDuel / JoinLobby subscribe only — no client can push

div.style: color: rgb(11, 18, 32) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: /health · /api/diag/smoke — .AllowAnonymous()

div.style: color: rgb(11, 18, 32) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: MapRazorPages().AllowAnonymous() — /diag (masks secret values)

div.style: color: rgb(11, 18, 32) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
/auth/me · /auth/login · /auth/login/microsoft · /auth/logout — .AllowAnonymous()
/auth/login/fake — .AllowAnonymous(), registered only when !IsProduction()

div.style: color: rgb(11, 18, 32) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: MapStaticAssets · /favicon.ico · MapFallbackToFile — .AllowAnonymous()

div.style: color: rgb(11, 18, 32) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
POST /api/dev/reset · POST /api/dev/remap-model-ids
.AllowAnonymous(), mapped only when IsDevelopment()

span.p: 1 UseSerilogRequestLogging — enriches CorrelationId, UserId, SessionId, RequestPath

div.style: color: rgb(11, 18, 32) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
2 UseExceptionHandler → RFC 7807 problem+json;
detail + stackTrace only in Development

div.style: color: rgb(11, 18, 32) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: 3 CSP header: frame-ancestors 'self' (the sandboxed preview iframe depends on it)

div.style: color: rgb(11, 18, 32) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: 4 (Development only) MapOpenApi + MapScalarApiReference — both AllowAnonymous

div.style: color: rgb(11, 18, 32) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: 5 /_framework → Cache-Control: no-cache, must-revalidate

div.style: color: rgb(11, 18, 32) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
6 UseBlazorFrameworkFiles + UseStaticFiles
— serve BEFORE auth so the SPA shell and .wasm never 401

div.style: color: rgb(11, 18, 32) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: 7 UseRouting

div.style: color: rgb(11, 18, 32) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
8 UseAuthentication — Cookie 'PoLocalCompare.Session'
HttpOnly · SameSite=Strict · SecurePolicy=Always · 8 h sliding

div.style: color: rgb(11, 18, 32) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
9 UseAuthorization — DefaultPolicy = RequireAuthenticatedUser
FallbackPolicy = DefaultPolicy (deny by default)

Microsoft account (OIDC code+PKCE)
issuer must match ^login.microsoftonline.com/{guid}/v2.0$
or AzureAd:AllowedTenants when populated

route registered only when !IsProduction()

FakeAuthHandler THROWS if constructed in Production
